model.name: R19.57: Full-width drawer must not cover the top-nav back button — back stays visible and clickable.
model.description: BUG (regression from R19.52 full-width drawer): the detail drawer now covers/hides the top-nav back button (←). FIX: the back button MUST stay visible and clickable above the drawer at all times. The drawer's z-index or layout must not overlap the top navigation bar. Either the drawer starts below the top-nav, or the top-nav has a higher z-index than the drawer.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "drawer is now full width but back button hidden underneath."
model.crossRefNote: R19.52 (full-width drawer) caused this regression. R19.57 is the constraint that R19.52 must respect: drawer full-width YES, but not over the top-nav back button.
